node.description:
The adventure is over but life goes on for an elf mage just beginning to learn what living is all about.

Elf mage Frieren and her courageous fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land. With the great struggle over, they all go their separate ways to live a quiet life. But as an elf, Frieren, nearly immortal, will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to terms with the mortality of her friends? How can she find fulfillment in her own life, and can she learn to understand what life means to the humans around her? Frieren begins a new journey to find the answer.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Notes:
- Winner of the Grand Prize at the 14th Manga Taisho Awards.
- Nominated for the 25th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.
- Placed 3rd at the 7th Annual Next Manga Award.

Music video directed by Keisuke Hiroe for the song Yuusha by YOASOBI. The song is based on a special novel written by Jirou Kiso, supervised by Kanehito Yamada.

Note: The song featured in this music video also serves as the first opening theme of the anime Sousou no Frieren. There exists two versions of this video; the first being a Japanese version uploaded on September 29, 2023 and an English version of the song titled "The Brave" by YOASOBI, which was uploaded on November 24, 2023.

node.description:
Following the First-Class Mage Exam, the trio—elven mage Frieren, warrior Stark, and first-class mage Fern—gains access to the dangerous Northern Plateau. As the party presses onward toward Aureole, formidable adversaries force Stark to confront his insecurities, solidifying his resolve and his role as the party's frontliner. Meanwhile, Fern continues to cherish the gifts she has been blessed with throughout her life, each a reminder of those she holds dear.

Frieren—still honoring her vow to understand humanity—revisits memories of her journey with the Hero's party and her fleeting encounter with a legendary figure. As she reflects on the passage of time, the elven mage quietly questions whether she has truly changed, yet in the small, almost subtle choices that she makes, there are signs that she might have become more human than she realizes.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

node.description:
A second batch of the ●● no Mahou shorts released monthly in the lead up to the TV anime's second season, starting with #12. Posted on the official YouTube account of TOHO animation, Frieren Twitter, and Frieren TikTok account.

Includes:
• Shinchou ga Nobiru Mahou (身長が伸びる魔法), released Apr 2, 2025.
• Onaka-ippai ni Naru Mahou (おなかいっぱいになる魔法), released May 7, 2025.
• Daitai Nan demo Kiru Mahou (大体なんでも切る魔法), released Jun 4, 2025.
• Kousoku de Idou Suru Mahou (高速で移動する魔法), released Jul 2, 2025.
• Karada no Mawari wo Suzushiku Suru Mahou (体のまわりを涼しくする魔法), released Aug 6, 2025.
• Tokui Waza wo Fuujiru Mahou (得意技を封じる魔法), released Sep 3, 2025.
